name: Huadeng Zhanye
source:
An Illuminator dressed in magnificent attire, in charge of Starshard Beacon, with formidable combat abilities. Although she leaves an impression of confidence and strength on others, in daily life, she is actually friendly and cares about other Illuminators. In a sense, she can be considered as someone with a cold face but a warm heart.

[spoiler]She is the de facto leader of Light Pollution rebel group opposing the Main Beacon and Bonfia Flame leadership.

She hates this painful and uncontrollable reality, even more so since Intimia’s death. Therefore, she has been trying to find a way to change the current situation and destroy Darkritters.[/spoiler]
